paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.61% on average, with Nasdaq strongest (+1.07%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-0.34%). Brent crude changed -4.54% to 111.42. Gold changed +0.69% to 4,035.7. Bitcoin changed +0.44% to 80,372.2578. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.982%, a relative move of -0.12%. Among the firms tracked, Vale (-3.47%) and Santander (-3.44%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Bon Secours agrees $5.7bn takeover of Bain-backed Surgery Partners (FT Markets). US hospital chain is the latest not-for-profit healthcare provider to strike a large deal Deals and capital markets: Anthropic begins countdown to IPO with prospectus filing (FT Markets). 240,000-word prospectus lays out explosive growth alongside steep losses and daunting risk factors Geopolitics and trade: Singapore to store Saudi Arabian oil in caverns (FT Markets). Agreement with Saudi Aramco aims to secure energy supplies for south-east Asia amid Middle East war disruption Also ranking highly: Marc Lore’s Wonder bets on Texas, automation and user-built restaurants as it mulls IPO (CNBC). Wonder is leaning into automation and user-built restaurants as founder Marc Lore prepares the startup for a potential IPO. Also ranking highly: Survey on the Access to Finance of Enterprises: lending conditions tightened (ECB).
